principles.public_site: Never expose API keys in browser JavaScript. Prefer GitHub Actions/server-side fetch and publish only data or derived outputs whose license permits public display.
principles.raw_market_data: Do not commit vendor raw market data to this public repository unless redistribution/display rights are explicitly confirmed.
principles.point_in_time: Store observation_date, release_date, retrieval_date and revision/vintage flags separately whenever the source supports them.
